dataset_title: OORVEX Kerala 14 District Cultural Heritage Dataset – Expanded History
usage_note: Expanded editorial starter dataset. History fields include additional context and suggested editorial sections, but they are not a substitute for source verification. District associations are not necessarily exclusive origins. Verify historical claims, localities, venues, community consent, image rights and visitor access before marking records as Verified.

image_approval_workflow: Find an image that depicts the exact art form, craft or district.
Open the original source page and confirm the image belongs to the stated subject and locality.
Check the licence and whether reuse, editing and website publication are allowed.
Record photographer, source URL, licence, caption and descriptive alt text.
Upload the image to the OORVEX media library.
Preview it beside the correct district and art-form record.
Approve only after curator review; otherwise mark Needs Review.
